policies.arguments: Exact arity and primitive types only; never perform JavaScript string or numeric coercion. Reject unpaired UTF-16 surrogates, preserve embedded NUL bytes in UTF-8 conversion, and use length-aware native strings.
policies.authorization: Utility bindings do not mutate IRC state; randomness bindings consume the server random generator. The manifest grants no mutation authority.
policies.errors: Throw TypeError for wrong arity or type and malformed UTF-16; throw RangeError for results outside the documented numeric or string bounds. Native exceptions must become JavaScript Error without crossing the V8 callback boundary. No pending exception may be ignored.
policies.lifetime: All arguments are owned native copies for the duration of the synchronous adapter call. Return JavaScript-owned primitive values only. Do not retain native pointers, references, string_views, V8 locals, or user/channel objects across calls.
policies.registration: Only entries in bindings are emitted as registration rows. Inventory entries, including proposed mutation names, never produce callbacks or TypeScript methods. Handwritten native adapters must implement the declared conversion and policy contracts.
policies.scope: Inventory covers public functions and callable hooks declared on InspIRCd in v4.12.1 inspircd.h, plus selected manager/pointer/container APIs and candidate UUID-resolved mutations. It is not an exhaustive binding of every API transitively included by inspircd.h.
